queries.label: cangrelor_pci_acs_randomised
queries.rationale: Broad intervention plus PCI/ACS condition query intended to retrieve randomized cangrelor PCI trials without naming trial identifiers.

params.query.cond: acute coronary syndrome OR myocardial infarction OR percutaneous coronary intervention

queries.label: cangrelor_clopidogrel_pci_randomised
queries.rationale: Names both molecules and the PCI setting so the active-comparator contrast can be found before screening, without seeding NCT identifiers.

queries.label: cangrelor_synonyms_coronary_randomised
queries.rationale: Adds cangrelor synonym and brand-style terms with coronary disease terms to catch registrations whose intervention naming differs from the generic drug name.

params.query.cond: atherosclerosis OR acute coronary syndrome OR coronary intervention
params.query.intr: cangrelor OR Kengreal OR Kengrexal OR AR-C69931MX

known_limitation: This is one registry, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, and no bibliographic database. Recall will be recall of this registry search, not recall of the literature; it may miss trials absent from ClinicalTrials.gov, miscoded registry records, or publication-only evidence.
